thread:
joan (acct_exec): Quick thread — Onyx (Edge Systems) wants to run their 'edge-onyx-30b' model through our private stack for a week-long POC. Key asks: p50 <100ms for chat, VPC + KMS, EU data residency. Need compatibility check + cost estimate. I have an s3 link.
emma (sales_eng): Can someone run a compatibility probe? We need sequence-length behavior, KV-cache support on quantized builds, memory footprint, and whether our fast-path kernels trigger.
zach (solutions): Do they ship QLoRA or a standard HF state_dict? They mentioned custom fused ops in the meeting — could be a blocker for our compiled kernels.
liam (infra): I can run our adapter tests. Please share the weights link + model config (tokenizer, config.json). Also need expected concurrency and typical request lengths.
joan (acct_exec): S3 link is in my DM to the team. POC kickoff scheduled next Wed — can we get scan + rough cost by Tue EOD?
emma (sales_eng): I'll trigger the scan once I have the link. Example command I'll use: ```redwoodctl model scan --source s3://onx/edge-onyx-30b.pt --format pt --max-seq 4096 --output report.json``` 
deploy-bot: model-scan: job 6821 submitted for edge-onyx-30b — status: queued
zach (solutions): If the scan flags unsupported ops, fallback plan: serve a slightly larger non-quantized variant on dedicated nodes, or use a conversion step (torchscript/onnx) if feasible.
anas (security): Security notes: customer requires KMS for key management, full audit logs, and SSO via SAML. Also confirm model licensing (no restricted third-party artifacts). They want EU residency (eu-west-1).
joan (acct_exec): They claimed permissive license verbally; we must validate before any private deploy. Sales won't sign until SSO + SOC2 items are cleared.
emma (sales_eng): Pricing question from them: baseline 1M tokens/day, spikes up to ~4M. Interested in a committed dedicated pool + burst. Can we sketch numbers quickly?
liam (infra): Back-of-envelope: 30B fp16 on A100-class gives ~300k tokens/hr per pod with our batching defaults. For 1M/day baseline you'd need ~14 pod-hours/day; for spikes a 5-pod dedicated pool with autoscale should suffice. I'll run the cost sim and give hourly/daily numbers.
emma (sales_eng): Also need to call out latency tradeoffs: quantization will reduce memory but may force slow-path for KV cache in our runtime — that impacts p50.
zach (solutions): If they need strict 100ms p50, we should recommend a non-quantized variant or smaller seq-length window and aggressive caching of prefixes.
anas (security): I'll draft a minimal KMS/SSO checklist and attach the security questionnaire link. Also need to validate their incident response process.
joan (acct_exec): Action items: @liam run compatibility + cost sim by Tue EOD, @emma prepare quick pricing sketch and share scan command output, @anas draft KMS/SSO checklist and share the questionnaire link. I'll confirm license and push kickoff calendar invite.
emma (sales_eng): Got it — I'll post scan output in this thread and ping again if the probe needs extra files. :thumbsup:
liam (infra): Starting the scan now. Will post the report.json and perf logs.
deploy-bot: model-scan: job 6821 status: running
joan (acct_exec): Great — thanks everyone. If the scan is clean we'll propose a 30-day POC with dedicated pool + audit logs as a deliverable. I'll update Onyx after we have the report. :wave:
